comments:
Corresponds to the "Tik+ka" listed A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 523, No. 11319: [phya pa chos seng gi...] dbu ma rgyan [gsum] gyi Tik ka).

Commentary on Śāntarakṣita’s Madhyamakālaṃkāravṛtti (ID:3733), with some references to a “commentator” (ti ka byed) and to numerous anonymous opponents. Like in the commentary on the Satyadvayavibhaṅga (see (ID:5874)), the author uses a question-and-answer style to explain the words of the text. A few lemmas hint to a different translation of the base text. In particular, the verse MA 1 is cited in a version different from the canonical one.

The descriptive title given in the conclusive verses ex006052026-04-2303-27-06 - dbu ma brgyan gyi rtogs sla byis pa'i 'jug ngogs su rnam par phye - resembles the title in the colophon of his commentary on the Madhyamakāloka (see (ID:4482): bde blag du rtogs pa byis pa'i 'jug ngogs (ms: ngos) su sbyar ba). 

In the text, Phya pa refers the reader to two of his compositions for the details of the proof of emptiness, which he names "shes rab gsum la 'jug pa" and "'jug ngogs bsdu bar bstan la phab pa" (ex006052026-04-2303-25-27 pointed out in [5ENG67Z7]: 82, n. 22). The second could be his commentary on the Madhyamakāloka (ID:4482) on account of the similarity of title; the first could be the dBu ma de kho na nyid kyi snying po (ID:4486) or a work yet unknown.
This means that this commentary on the Madhyamakālaṃkāravṛtti would post-date the other two madhyamaka works, dBu ma de kho na nyid kyi snying po being the earliers as it is mentioned in the commentary on the Madhyamakāloka (ID:4482).

Edition and translation of some portions of the work in [WLWGS439]: appendix and footnotes.
